notes: Sold in Europe/Asia as "EB-L730U". Grades: HDMI inputs/output support HDCP 2.3 and accept a 4K signal (downscaled to native WUXGA 1920x1200), but the spec sheet does not state an HDMI version number, so HDMI grade is omitted per instructions (spec doesn't state version). RJ-45 speed is not explicitly stated on this 2-page sheet, so grade omitted rather than guessed. VGA (Mini D-Sub 15-pin) x2 are inputs (labeled Computer1/Computer2); a separate Mini D-Sub 15-pin "Monitor Out" is a VGA pass-through output. Audio In Mini Stereo x2 (Audio1/Audio2, 3.5mm TRS) pair with the video inputs; Variable Audio Out Mini Stereo x1 (3.5mm) feeds an external amp/speaker. USB-A is for media-player/USB-drive playback and wireless LAN module; USB-B is for USB display/mouse control from a computer (both treated as bidirectional per USB-host convention; USB spec version not stated, listed as usb-2.0 as the typical baseline for this port class, low-confidence inference). RS-232C is a standard D-Sub 9-pin serial control port. Power inlet is a detachable IEC C13/C14 cord as shown on the rear-panel diagram in the official spec sheet and confirmed by "power cable" being a boxed accessory; rated 100-240V 50/60Hz, 358W (Normal Mode). Built-in Wireless LAN (802.11b/g/n) is omitted as a physical port since it has no external connector on this model. Desktop/tabletop unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted).
